Done. `analysis.py` (685 lines) implements the coupled Farquhar(C3)/Collatz(C4) + Ball-Berry model exactly as the brief states it, with your three rulings applied (PAR ≤ 1e-6 W m⁻² ⇒ night branch; CLM esat + R = 8.317 as declared header conventions; undamped successive substitution from `ci_init_pa`, tol |ΔCi| < 1e-8 Pa, cap 200, bisection fallback present and asserted unused). Artifacts delivered: `analysis.py`, `results/leaf_fluxes.csv`, `results/case_convergence.csv`, `results/diurnal.png`.

**Active physics.** `pathway = "C4"` ⇒ Wc = Vcmax, Wj = α_q·APAR, We = 4000·Vcmax·Ci/p_atm, A = hard-min − Rd, APAR = 4.6·PAR; Vcmax = Q10-2.4 with the high-T inhibition denominator, scaled by n_factor (=1.0) and btran (=0.625) — capacity only, b0 = 0.04 unscaled; T_leaf = T_air; h_s = clip(1 − vpd/esat, 0.25, 1); cf chain with the 1.37/1.65 drawdowns using A_mol = A·1e-6. The C3 branch (Kc, Ko, Γ*, Wc/Wj with Γ*) is implemented and selectable but inactive for this parameter file.

**1) Case convergence — all values from the coupled fixed point, none copied.**

Every case moved ≥ 4.03 Pa from its start (5/5), including case_04 whose guess lies *above* ambient (c_a = 64.065 Pa) and falls 39.27 Pa onto the fixed point — the reported state is a solved coupling, not the initial guess or per-column filling. All five converge to the identical state from guesses spanning 0.1–1.1·c_a; residuals are exactly 0 because the converged map reproduces Ci bit-for-bit. Independent closure test straight off the CSV columns: recomputing cs, gs = cf/rs and Ci = cs − 1.65·rs·A/cf·p from the reported A/rs/ci gives 0.00e+00 mismatch in both the Ci closure and the Ball-Berry-vs-cf/gs closure. Sun and shade coincide at row 12 (both Vcmax-limited), so the unspecified leaf type is immaterial; `ci_shade` was computed anyway = 31.204631 Pa for all cases.

**2) Regime switching — the 15 dawn/dusk rows where shade is Wj-limited.** Identical pattern each of the 5 days at hours 7, 16, 17 (indices 7, 16, 17 + 24k): sun is Wc-limited on all 55 light rows; shade is Wc-limited 40/55 and Wj-limited 15/55.

| 7, 31, 55, 79, 103 (d1–5) | 7 | 463.99 / 92.80 | 85.37 / 17.07 | 22.175 | 21.843 | 16.742 | Wc / **Wj** | 45.481 / 46.873 |
| 16, 40, 64, 88, 112 | 16 | 896.36 / 179.27 | 164.93 / 32.99 | 39.805 | 39.207 | 32.389 | Wc / **Wj** | 39.647 / 40.885 |
| 17, 41, 65, 89, 113 | 17 | 463.99 / 92.80 | 85.37 / 17.07 | 36.679 | 36.129 | 16.525 | Wc / **Wj** | 42.571 / 46.897 |

Regime-switch sanity: shade A = Wj_sh − Rd (17.07 − 0.55 = 16.53 ✓ at idx 17); shade Ci exceeds sun Ci where shade is light-limited but equals it at midday when both are capacity-limited — the expected signature. We never binds at a converged state (4000·Vcmax·Ci/p_atm = 48.7 > Vcmax = 39.8 at row 12); it binds only *during* iteration from low-Ci starts, which is why 2–3 iterations are needed rather than 1.

**3) Physical sanity checks (11/11 ok, computed on the written CSVs).** No NaN/Inf anywhere; light gs ≥ b0 (min 0.0400 = b0 exactly at threshold rows, max 0.3900); rs strictly positive everywhere including night (107.1–1082.1 s m⁻¹); A > 0 on all 55 light rows, A < 0 at night (= −Rd, −0.225…−0.494); Ci < cs < c_a in light for both leaves; A_sun range [−0.494, 41.988]. Night rows: gs = b0 = 0.04 exactly, rs = cf/b0 = 1048.5–1082.1 s m⁻¹, all finite at PAR = 0 by construction. Two consecutive runs give identical md5sums for both CSVs; an independent brute-force implementation (20 000-point sign scan + bisection, no shared code) matches the CSVs to ≤ 2.3×10⁻¹³ with exactly one root per leaf-row; series Ci is warm-start independent to 7×10⁻¹⁵ Pa over starts 0.05–3.0 × c_a.

**4) Flagged conventions (also header conventions C1–C8).** (a) **Night Ci comes from the diffusion chain**, not forced to c_a or cs, so night Ci = 65.04–66.21 Pa > cs > c_a = 64.06 Pa — correct for a respiring leaf; if your reference forces Ci = cs or ca, only those 65 night `ci_*` values change. (b) The night threshold classifies 65 rows (60 exact zeros + the 5 sinusoid-residue rows at PAR = 2.195e-13); treating those 5 as light would leave A = −Rd unchanged but give gs = 0.0350, rs ≈ 1192. (c) CLM esat and R = 8.317 are declared, not confirmed; sensitivity < 0.1%. (d) Γ* implemented literally as 0.5·(Kc/Ko)·O₂·0.21 (double-counts the 21% O₂ fraction ⇒ 0.87–1.71 Pa) — irrelevant because pathway = C4.

**Limitations.** (i) This sandbox has no matplotlib and no network (pip fails on DNS), so `diurnal.png` (1160×760, 17.3 KB, two stacked panels: A and rs for sun vs shaded, night hours shaded, 12 h ticks, legends) was produced by a dependency-free renderer I wrote into `analysis.py` (zlib PNG + 5×7 bitmap font); the matplotlib branch remains the primary path and was mock-smoke-tested (2 curves + legend + title + ylabel per panel, savefig reached) but never rendered to a real PNG here. (ii) Ambient CO₂ of 64.06 Pa is physically extreme; taken at face value it makes Vcmax the binding limitation at nearly every light row, so A ≈ Vcmax − Rd and Ci is set by the gs–diffusion balance rather than by We — a different intended reading of that column would change all Ci/A/gs values. (iii) Case leaf type assumed sunlit (verified immaterial at row 12).
